get_ee_pose: get the end-effector pose as position and quaternion in base or world frame
goto_joint_positions: command the stretch robot arm to move to specified joint positions with optional relative mode
goto_ee_pose: command the robot gripper to move to a target end-effector pose using inverse kinematics
open_gripper_close_gripper: open or close the robot gripper to its full range with optional blocking behavior
rotate_ee: rotate the robot end-effector by a specified angle around one of the X, Y, or Z axes
